Metal Wolf.name: Metal Wolf
Metal Wolf.summary: Metal Wolf is an Adventure game, developed and published by Princess Soft, which was released in Japan in 2002.

Who Wants to Beat Up a Millionaire.name: Who Wants to Beat Up a Millionaire
Who Wants to Beat Up a Millionaire.summary: Who Wants to Beat Up a Millionaire? is a video game parody of Who Wants to Be a Millionaire?. It was created by Hypnotixc Inc, and released in 2000 by Simon & Schuster Interactive for Windows 95, Windows 98, and Sega Dreamcast.
